id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_070.pack|cs_: "Ugh... What a sight... Could this be the hermit who came up alone?
"It must be. Seated in meditation as he died, he surely met death prepared.
"But I've seen this posture somewhere...
"Hm...! This is Issue One of the Ogler's Digest, and in mint condition!
"A blessing in misfortune. Wretched as the end was, he surely went to heaven wrapped in happiness.
"Hm...? This is a necklace of the Dundrasil royal family!? Why does this poor hermit have it...
"N-No! Could this hermit be...
"Lord Robert!!
"Lord Robert was the Grand Master's favorite disciple. He must have chosen a peaceful end on hearing of his death.
"No, wait! He's still breathing!
"What!?
"Lord Robert's soul is wandering between life and death. But as it is, he will die.
"No, there may be one way to save him.
"{var:1} could go to the netherworld, the realm between life and death, and bring Lord Robert back.
"The netherworld...? But how? Is that possible?
"This shrine on the summit has long been said to connect to the netherworld.
"If I perform the temple's soul-parting rite and separate your soul from your body, you can enter it.
"But it is a world where life and death waver. As a living person, you may never return.
"{var:1}, will you still go to the netherworld to save Lord Robert, your grandfather?
"{var:1}, there's no time to hesitate. If we don't act soon, Lord Robert will truly die.
"Then I ask again. Think carefully before answering.
"...Understood. Then I will send you to the netherworld. Tell me when your heart is ready."
